Help-center excerpts:

[close-inactivity] Inactive accounts (effective 2025-01-01)
We may close accounts that have a $0.00 balance and no activity for 12 months.

## Notice

We email you at least 30 days before closing. Any activity during that time, such as a deposit or a card purchase, keeps the account open.

## Fees

We don't charge inactivity fees ($0.00) on any plan.

## Accounts with money in them

We don't close accounts for inactivity while they hold a balance, including money in Savings Pockets.

## Paid plans

A paid plan keeps charging its monthly fee while the account is open, which counts

[close-how] How to close your account (effective 2025-01-01)
You can close your Tallowbrook account in the app, or ask support to close it for you.

## Before you close

Your account can only be closed when:

- No transactions are pending
- No disputes are open
- Your balance isn't negative

Also move money out of your Savings Pockets and switch your direct deposit and any automatic payments to another account.

## Close in the app

Tap Profile, then Close account. The app checks the requirements, shows where any remaining money will go, and asks you to confirm.

## Closing through support

Support can close your account for

[close-blockers] Why can't I close my account? (effective 2025-01-01)
whether it's from Cushion or from a reversed credit.

## Account restricted or under review

If your account is restricted or under review, support can't close it. Message us and we'll pass your request to the team that manages the review.

## Still stuck?

Message support with the reason the app gives. We'll tell you exactly what's left to do.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[close-how] How to close your account (effective 2025-01-01)
asks you to confirm.

## Closing through support

Support can close your account for you when the balance is $0.00 and the requirements above are met. If there's money left, move it out first or close in the app, which sends it to you.

## Plan fees

Plan fees aren't refunded or prorated when you close, except under the cooling-off rule for a first paid plan charge.

Closing is permanent. A closed account can't be reopened.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[close-reopen] Reopening a closed account (effective 2025-01-01)
request them.

## If we closed your account

If Tallowbrook closed your account, for example after a review, you may not be able to open a new one. Support can't reverse that decision.

## Inactive accounts

If your account was closed for inactivity, you can apply again at any time.

## Your old account details

Update your employer and any companies that paid into your old account. Payments sent to a closed account are returned to the sender.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[close-blockers] Why can't I close my account? (effective 2025-01-01)
If the app won't let you close your account, one of these is usually the reason.

## Pending transactions

Wait until everything has posted. Card authorizations usually post or drop off within a few days.

## Open disputes

We can't close an account while a dispute is open, because the outcome may add or remove money. Most disputes finish within 45 days. If the merchant refunded you, you can withdraw the dispute.

## Negative balance

Add money to bring the balance back to zero, whether it's from Cushion or from a reversed credit.

## Account restricted

[close-reopen] Reopening a closed account (effective 2025-01-01)
Closed accounts can't be reopened. If you'd like to come back, apply for a new account in the app.

## What a new account means

- New account and card numbers
- New verification. You'll go through identity checks again.
- Your old transaction history stays with the closed account.
- Any cooling-off refund for a first paid plan charge only applies once per person.

## Statements from the old account

You can download statements for 90 days after closing. After that, message support to request them.

## If we closed your account

[support-financial-abuse] If someone is controlling your money (effective 2025-01-01)
If someone is controlling your money, pressuring you to hand it over, or using your account without your permission, you're not alone, and we can help.

## Tell us safely

Message support in the app when it's safe. You can use a code phrase like "I need to talk about my account security" if someone might see your screen. Support will pass your case to our Account Services team, who are trained to help.

## What we can do

- Change your password and sign out other devices
- Freeze or replace your card
- Stop sending paper mail to

Customer question:
Will you close my account if I don't use it?

request.instructions:
You are the help-center assistant for Tallowbrook, a US neobank. Answer the customer's question using only the help-center excerpts you are given.

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.
